interventions.native_operation: all four sensory-location rows rolled +1 at fixed history
interventions.patch_operation: delivery command rows rolled +1; after recomposed; no hidden-state re-inference
interventions.source_precedence: Readdressed sensory memory and patched represented forecasts define current diagnostic contents; retained history describes actual past deliveries, not proof of current content placement or patched future outcomes.

risk_associations.limitations: Associations and decoder error contrasts do not isolate appearance from decision uncertainty.
